name: dev-skills
description: Repo-agnostic skills for the full software engineering loop: requirements, spec, QA, implementation, investigation, PR review and follow-up, deploys, monitoring, sprint planning and standups. Detects each project's tracker, PR host, deploy method and observability on its own.

mode.title: Autonomy mode
mode.description: autonomous: asks only before external writes (push, PR, comments, tickets, messages, deploys, shared data). balanced: also before commits and risky local changes. guided: also approves the spec and QA plan before coding.
